scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.reset: npm run clear && npm run seed
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w apps/api && node --test scripts/api.test.cjs scripts/assistant.test.cjs
scripts.eval:assistant: npm run build -w apps/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/assistant-eval.cjs
